steps.content: Shivering, Hella is curled up in Ninety-Nine's embrace, covering her eyes wide with fear and trembling all over.
The image of that person covered in blood and reaching out a hand to her is too terrifying. Hella is still unable to shake that deep fear.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: It's okay, Hella... I'm here.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: He can't hurt you... Nobody can hurt you...
steps.female_content: She can't hurt you... Nobody can hurt you...

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Stay here, stay next to me, don't go anywhere...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Stay here... Don't go... anywhere...?
Where is she? Where did she want to go?

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Don't overthink... You're already spooked out... Don't force yourself to go back.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Go back... to where...?
Her memories have blurred. Not long ago, she seemed to be going in circles in a super weird amusement park. She didn't like that place, but still she followed someone there.
Because ${PlayerName} wanted to go there. ${PlayerName} said it was important for him. So Hella tagged along.
steps.female_content: Because ${PlayerName} wanted to go there. ${PlayerName} said it was important for her. So Hella tagged along.

steps.content: That person brings too much trouble. I simply had to go and help.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Where is ${PlayerName}?

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I pushed him away. You know full well too, that one's a monster who will harm you. You've seen the real him.
steps.female_content: I pushed her away. You know full well too, that one's a monster who will harm you. You've seen the real her.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'd never seen him like that before... It was so scary...
steps.female_content: I'd never seen her like that before... It was so scary...

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Yes, you don't know him at all. That person is dangerous, we must stay away from him.
steps.female_content: Yes, you don't know her at all. That person is dangerous, we must stay away from her.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Stay here, stay next to me. This is the only place where you don't need to feel any fear.
Phantom Ninety-Nine's arms wrapping around Hella grow firmer, locking her in tightly, wanting to keep her in this illusory realm forever.
Hella squeezes her eyes shut, but her body still hasn't stopped trembling.
...Are you still... worried about him?
A vague voice suddenly rings in Hella's ears.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Who? Who's talking?
He's... looking for you too. In order to find you, he's fighting with all his might... alone...
steps.female_content: She's... looking for you too. In order to find you, she's fighting with all her might... alone...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Is he in trouble?!
Hella's eyes snap open. She can't find the voice's owner, but sees a hint of light blue glow vanish before her eyes.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey! Explain! What happened to ${PlayerName}?!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Hella, what's the matter?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I need to go back! I knew it, that idiot has gotten himself in trouble again, I need to go back and save him!
steps.female_content: I need to go back! I knew it, that idiot has gotten herself in trouble again, I need to go back and save her!

steps.content: Ninety-Nine grabs Hella's shoulders hard.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: That's not the ${PlayerName} you know! That's a monster, a monster that will harm you!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Aren't you scared of him?!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I am!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I get scared when Ninety-Nine go nuts and bite me too. You all do these crazy things all the time. I'll admit I'm not the bravest person in the world, it's normal to feel scared from time to time!
She shouts, all her reactions here genuine and unconcealed in this place.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I remember it now. ${PlayerName} became like that to save Zoya.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: He looked like a different person at the time not because he'd changed, but because he was being tortured, he'd suffered so much! I'd never seen ${PlayerName} look so agonized, and it was all for saving a friend.
steps.female_content: She looked like a different person at the time not because she'd changed, but because she was being tortured, she'd suffered so much! I'd never seen ${PlayerName} look so agonized, and it was all for saving a friend.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ${PlayerName} has never changed, he's always been that dumb idiot I know! I must go back and save him!
steps.female_content: ${PlayerName} has never changed, she's always been that dumb idiot I know! I must go back and save her!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: You can't go! Your heart hasn't regained peace. It's confused and nervous, you're feeling scared!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'm just pissed! Pissed that I can't do anything, so pissed!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: That's my friend, you know? I'm all about protecting my friends, like I always protect Ninety-Nine!
She struggles free from the constraint and stands up. Ninety-Nine's figure is beginning to blur.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I recall now. I recall everything now, about that idiot, about you too. You're definitely not Ninety-Nine.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ninety-Nine will never ask me to abandon my friend! Don't ******* pretend to be her and say these disgusting words to me!
